orgtree retried this turn automatically and has now stopped. You are no longer frozen, so this message is itself a live turn — you are running right now.

⚠ WORK MAY BE UNFINISHED AND UNSAVED. A turn died part-way through, possibly more than once. Anything it had already done — files edited, mail sent, commands run — DID happen and was not undone; anything it was about to do did not. Before redoing work, CHECK THE ACTUAL STATE: your working folder, `git status` if you are in a repo, and your own last messages. Then finish what was interrupted, or report that you cannot.
